text:
Evan: heads-up 1 run run_2026_04_12_02 produced ~37 invoices with incorrect line amounts (currency rounding issue) and 10 customers received duplicate PDFs. opening thread for triage.
Margo: can you share sample invoice ids and affected accounts?
Evan: samples: INV-ORC-312, INV-FLX-078, INV-PLN-900. accounts: acct-orchid, acct-flexwork, acct-planity. customers report small amount mismatches (few cents) and duplicates.
Sahil: support got first report from Orchid at 05:42 UTC. ticket FIN-10644 created. PDF shows seat prorations but totals off by -0.02 USD and there are two attachments named inv_INV-ORC-312_v1.pdf and inv_INV-ORC-312_v2.pdf.
Rae: I pulled billing pipeline logs. Two separate issues: 1) currency conversion stage used bankrate snapshot with millisecond skew, causing rounding drift when summing prorated seat lines; 2) object-store (S3) put operations returned eventual-consistency race for identical object names when quick retries occurred, producing duplicates. Also retries were happening without idempotency keys.
Rae: log snippet:
```
2026-04-12T05:41:02Z ERROR currency: CurrencyConversionMismatch invoice=INV-ORC-312 rate_ts=2026-04-12T05:40:59.432Z
2026-04-12T05:41:03Z WARN retry: requeued job id=70122 idempotency_key=null
2026-04-12T05:41:04Z INFO s3: PutObject returned 200 for key=inv_INV-ORC-312.pdf (possible race)
```
Margo: ok that maps to both symptoms. need list of affected accounts so collections can pause and CS can prep comms.
Evan: initial list from support: acct-orchid, acct-flexwork, acct-planity, acct-nimble-4, acct-harbor-2 (37 invoices flagged, 10 duplicates confirmed so far).
Sahil: finance exposure estimate?
Evan: rough calc ~ $760 (rounding deltas + small proration mismatches). will confirm after enumeration.
Rae: proposed fixes: 1) pin currency snapshot per run with microsecond alignment to avoid drift, 2) use high-precision decimal arithmetic during line aggregation, 3) make S3 writes atomic with unique object names (uid suffix) and then atomically rename/confirm, 4) ensure idempotency_key is present on retries. estimate deploy + backfill ~2h.
Margo: please pause nightly billing run until patch is live.
Rae: paused runner: `systemctl stop invoice-nightly` on batch10. Deploy started for branch billing/currency-s3-race-fix.
ops-bot: Deploy started for billing/currency-s3-race-fix -> staging
Sahil: CS will draft proactive messaging; offering $10 courtesy credit for affected customers due to rounding confusion. holding responses until regen completes.
Rae: dry-run backfill: `python billing/backfill.py --run run_2026_04_12_02 --dry-run` -> found 37 invoices with rounding deltas, 10 duplicate PDF keys. saving enumeration to /tmp/billing_1787001234.csv
Evan: finance please don't post credits until we confirm final numbers.
billing-bot: Deploy to production succeeded for billing/currency-s3-race-fix @ 2026-04-12T07:22:10Z
Rae: prod backfill finished: regenerated 37 invoices with corrected decimal math and unique object naming, removed 10 duplicate keys, uploaded corrected PDFs, queued resend of emails. summary:
```
backfill_summary: regenerated=37, deduped=10, rounding_adjustment_total=0.89, duration=38m
```
Margo: finance preparing credit memos for $760 (includes courtesy credits). attaching approval FIN-APPR-704. will post journals after CS confirms sends.
Sahil: CS will send corrected invoices and short explanation later today. template in #support. owners: Rae (fix + backfill), Sahil (customer comms), Margo (finance credits). please add postmortem once incident closed.
Evan: thanks team 1 add to postmortem: root cause = currency snapshot skew + non-atomic S3 writes + missing idempotency on retries. closing until postmortem.
